sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य मारीचः कश्यपो अब्रवीत् ।अदित्या देवतानाम् च मम च एव अनुयाचितम् ॥१-२९-१५॥
transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya mārīcaḥ kaśyapo abravīt ।adityā devatānām ca mama ca eva anuyācitam ॥1-29-15॥

translations.english: Having heard those words of Vishnu, Kasyapa, son of Maricha, replied, "O bestower of boons, O great practitioner of austerities Be pleased to grant a boon for Aditi, devatas and for myself.
